compiled_state.title: GREEN: schema version bump and SNAPSHOT rebuild with dry-run and rollback
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Create one-shot migration script plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.sh. Makes T14-pre tests pass.

Behavior:
1. --dry-run flag: print 'DRY_RUN: would bump schema_version to N', exit 0 without modifying any file
2. Without flags: create pre-migration SNAPSHOT backup (filename: SNAPSHOT.pre-migration.$(date +%s).json) before modifying anything
3. Bump schema_version to N in reducer constants
4. Rebuild SNAPSHOT by replaying all events through the updated reducer
5. --rollback flag: copy backup file back to SNAPSHOT.json and exit 0

Add migration invocation to the marker-gated migration chain (idempotent: check for migration marker before running, write marker on completion). Pattern: same as ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh — marker-gated, no-op once migrated, never blocks.

depends_on: T14-pre (e3a9-9c01)
Story DD coverage: SC6, SC7
Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-schema-hardening.sh --dry-run exits 0 and prints DRY_RUN line; bash ... --rollback restores backup
Retry budget: 2 attempts
